title: Weekend Visit Surcharge on Optional Coverage Add-Ons Service Calls
content:
A weekend visit surcharge is added to the rider visit fee of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider service request according to the day the request was placed:

| Day the request was placed | Weekend visit surcharge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | USD 40.00 |
| Saturday | USD 25.00 |
| Monday through Friday | None |

The day read is the request date of the rider service request the fee is charged on.

**Hypothetical cases.** A request placed on a Sunday and charged on the Tuesday after: USD 40.00 is added, since the day placed decides. A request placed on a Friday: nothing is added.
